profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a highly skilled software engineer with about 6 years of experience in both technical and leadership roles. I specialize in back-end technologies, particularly in Node.js and rest APIs, as well as Ruby on Rails and PostgreSQL. I am also proficient in front-end development, with experience using frameworks such as React.js and libraries like Material-UI. I am excited about the opportunity to join a team where I can share my expertise and continue to grow my skills while creating innovative and top-quality software.

Specialties: JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, React.js, MongoDB, Express, HTML, CSS, Ruby on Rails

GitHub: github.com/Melvin-Code

projects.title: Airtable-export-to-CSV
projects.description:
An API that can take any table from Airtable and export it to a CSV file

Technologies:
 ●  Express
 ●  Axios
 ●  Node.js
 ●  Heroku

Incoming Features:
 ●  Scraping capabilities to avoid using Airtable's API key and only shareable links
 ● Adding new file types for export

Feel free to message me with any recommendations or criticism about this project, so I can enhance the quality of my work. Thanks!!!
